column3: “Turn back the captivity” is rendered “restore the fortunes.”
“We have heard” is rendered “I have heard.”
The Hebrew has “your neck” and “your fetters”; NASB has “their neck” and “their bonds.”
“To a sore” is rendered “for your sore.”
“Bring up healing” is rendered “restore you to health.”
“Turn back the captivity” is rendered “restore the fortunes.”
The Hebrew has “its children” (Jacob); NASB has “Their children.”
“Staying as a sojourner” is rendered “sweeping”; the Hebrew is uncertain.
